gallery.filename: Hull City in the Premier League - geograph.org.uk - 817803.jpg
gallery.title: File:Hull City in the Premier League - geograph.org.uk - 817803.jpg
gallery.description: Hull City in the Premier League Hull City.... Premier League? String those two phrases together and it sounds a bit like comedian Peter Kay's "Garlic Bread" routine. Nevertheless the 104 year old football club has finally achieved what to many seemed impossible. Until two days ago, Hull had the unenviable distinction of being the largest conurbation in England never to have had a football team compete in the top division. Thanks to a spectacular goal by 39 year old Hull-born striker Dean Windass in the playoff final at Wembley, that dubious honour now passes to Plymouth. The picture is of crowds outside Ferens Art Gallery in Victoria Square trying to catch a glimpse of the players as they appear on the City Hall balcony.
categories: Flags in the East Riding of Yorkshire
